body:
I don't think a message is needed or appropriate, I'd keep this PR minimal and just add features for easily accessing the copyright, though I'd say it already is (and just linking to https://godotengine.org/license/ is sufficient generally), but IMO popping up a dialog will only worry those who are inexperienced, and annoy those who are aware

It's also going to cause worry in those who might just be playing around and making an internal project not for distribution, which does not require any licensing information

body:
I decided to add a warning because inexperienced people might not know that they have to comply with open source licenses.
I also made the proposal because I was confused by the Godot docs, I wasn't sure if linking to https://godotengine.org/license/ is enough because the documentation doesn't state that it also complies with thirdparty licenses, I think it only states that it complies with Godot license. I might be wrong, but that's how I interpreted it 😅 
If it indeed allows the developer to comply with thirdparty licenses as well, may I create a PR for the docs to state it explicitly?

As far as I have heard it's enough as it references them and links to them, but that's up for interpretation

But I think regardless it's important to clarify that showing a license listing in the UI is not the only way to comply with the licenses, and it's important to not imply that it is the only valid way, and I'd suggest to use the recomendation to copy the text to the output files whenever appropriate (i.e. on non-mobile, non-web projects)

I can't speak to that, but I think regardless having a popup with a warning is out of the scope of this and should be discussed separately, and someone with more legal knowledge would have to comment on the licensing requirements

But I think documenting how to generate a good text output of the licenses would be more helpful than a fixed block of text, especially since you can't filter out licenses that might not actually matter (some are editor specific, some 3D specific, some navigation specific, etc.)
